scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@octocodeai/octocode-contacts && npm run build --workspace=@octocodeai/octocode-webview && cd packages/telemetry && npm run build && cd ../tui && npm run build && cd ../mcp && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.build:offline: npm run build --workspace=@octocodeai/octocode-contacts && npm run build --workspace=@octocodeai/octocode-webview && cd packages/telemetry && npm run build && cd ../tui && npm run build && cd ../mcp && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build:offline && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
